$description: EXECUTAR / Desyng System — design tokens. SOT: ADR-SYSTEM.md (Accepted). Correction 2026-09-06: DESIGN-TOKENS-003 ('Modernismo Operacional Editorial') added as a second theme and set as the DEFAULT — see meta.defaultTheme and themes.modernismo-operacional. The values at this top level (color/font/fontSize/.../zIndex) now represent the 'executar-classic' theme specifically, kept byte-for-byte unchanged and still selectable via [data-theme='executar-classic'].

secondary.$description: Passes WCAG AA normal text (5.54:1 on canvas, 5.99:1 on surface). Corrected during Phase 2 build: neutral.10 (previous value) only reached 3.90-4.22:1 and failed the 4.5:1 normal-text minimum — see packages/design-tokens/src/contrast.test.ts.

muted.$description: Only reaches 3.90-4.22:1 — meets the 3:1 large-text/non-text minimum, NOT the 4.5:1 normal-text minimum. Restrict to text >=18px/400 or >=14px/600, decorative dividers, or disabled-state icons. Never use for body or caption-sized text (12-14px). Corrected during Phase 2 build from neutral.9, which failed even the 3:1 threshold on canvas (2.80:1).

secondary_hover_surface.$description: Pale hover-tint surface for outline/secondary buttons — added alongside the modernismo-operacional theme so packages/ui/src/styles.css can reference one semantic token instead of hardcoding a palette family name that only exists in one theme.

modernismo-operacional.$description: Modernismo Operacional Editorial (DESIGN-TOKENS-003, v1.0, 2026-09-06) — default theme as of this correction. Color/typography/geometry are theme-specific (this object); layout/breakpoint/grid/zIndex stay shared with executar-classic (see design-tokens.json's top level) since DESIGN-TOKENS-003 doesn't argue those need to differ structurally.

muted.$description: DESIGN-TOKENS-003's own primitive.color.neutral.500 (mapped step 7, #8B8D8C) fails WCAG AA even at the 3:1 large-text floor against surface.page (2.99:1 — see packages/design-tokens/src/contrast.test.ts). Remapped to neutral.8 (same value as text.secondary) instead of inventing an unreviewed primitive — a real accessibility bug found and fixed the same way text.secondary/text.muted were fixed in executar-classic.

secondary.$description: DESIGN-TOKENS-003 doesn't name a distinct secondary-action color (only a size/geometry spec for buttons). NORMALIZED choice: secondary = the same neutral.950 ('NOW/SELECTED = preto') the doc's own state hierarchy already uses for emphasis, rendered as an outline — keeps the doc's black=focus/selected logic instead of inventing an unrelated hue.

secondary_hover_surface.$description: Pale hover-tint surface for outline/secondary buttons — fixes a real cross-theme bug: packages/ui/src/styles.css hardcoded --color-azure-2 for this, which doesn't exist in this theme (family is 'blue', not 'azure'). Added as a proper semantic token in both themes instead.

warning_text.$description: DESIGN-TOKENS-003's own semantic.color.text.attention uses neutral.950 (dark text), not a tinted yellow — yellow.9 is light, so text on it must stay dark, matching the source doc exactly.

lg.$description: Capped at 8px — DESIGN-TOKENS-003's rules.shape.maxDefaultRadius is 8px; this theme has no radius token above md.

xl.$description: Capped at 8px, same reason as radius.lg.

pill.$description: DESIGN-TOKENS-003 explicitly sets rules.shape.pillByDefault: false — this theme has no true pill radius. Any component styled with --radius-pill (e.g. Button, Badge) renders as an 8px rounded rectangle instead of a capsule when this theme is active, honoring the rule at the token level rather than requiring every component to special-case the theme.

full.$description: Capped at 8px, same reason as radius.pill.

sm.$description: DESIGN-TOKENS-003's composition.shadow.default is 'none' and rules.effects.heavyShadow is false — static surfaces (cards, etc.) carry no shadow in this theme.

hover.$description: DESIGN-TOKENS-003's composition.shadow.floating — the only elevation this theme defines, reserved for genuinely floating/interactive states.
